summary.en-US: Fix stubborn Amazing Marvin browser bugs and add practical, opt-in workflow upgrades.

version.approval_notes: Marvin Enhancement Suite runs only on https://app.amazingmarvin.com/. Its four DOM-based modules process task information locally and make no extension-owned network requests. Task Unroller is off by default and separately requests access to https://serv.amazingmarvin.com/ plus optional authenticationInfo and websiteContent data consent; it sends user-provided credentials and task operations directly to Amazing Marvin only after the user enables and configures that feature. There is no analytics, telemetry, advertising, remote code, or maintainer-operated service. Build instructions and a versioned source archive are included with the submission.
